recognize_zh: 高倍下小型淋巴球核圓、染色質呈粗塊狀（足球樣/龜裂土樣，soccer ball / cracked earth），細胞質極少，並可見一顆核被抹開成條紋狀的 smudge cell，是 CLL 的典型抹片表現。
features: Small to slightly enlarged lymphocytes with a high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Round nuclei with coarsely clumped, block-like chromatin (soccer ball / cracked earth pattern)
No conspicuous nucleoli in most cells
Smudge cell with streaked, smeared nuclear chromatin in the center
Some lymphocytes with irregular, crumpled outlines (smear artifact)
Background red cells with numerous echinocytes (crenation artifact)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped block-like chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. A smudge cell with smeared, streaked nuclear material is present in the center of the field. Background red cells show numerous crenated forms, likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia, supported by the reported CD5+/CD19+/CD23+/CD200+ B-cell phenotype on flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: MCL cells tend to be more irregular with notched nuclei and are CD23/CD200 negative with cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity.
Prolymphocytes are larger with more cytoplasm and a single prominent central nucleolus, and smudge cells are less characteristic.
FL cells are small with deeply cleaved (buttock) nuclei and are CD10+/CD5- with t(14;18).
Reactive small lymphocytes are polyclonal and smudge cells are few, whereas CLL shows a monotonous clonal population with abundant smudge cells.
